exposure: Mode of delivery (Normal Delivery vs. Elective Caesarean Delivery)
cohort: The study enrolled 60 term neonates, with 30 born via normal delivery and 30 born via elective caesarean delivery.
finding: Babies born via caesarean section exhibited altered antioxidant levels and lower serum cortisol, which might predispose them to pathological conditions.
mod_finding: Caesarean-born neonates had significantly higher GPx and SOD activities, higher uric acid concentration, and lower serum cortisol compared to those born via normal delivery.
